query: SELECT s.conversation_id,c.owner_id,EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM templates t WHERE t.name=c.template AND 'desktop'=ANY(t.capabilities)) AS "desktop!" FROM sandbox_instances s JOIN conversations c ON c.id=s.conversation_id WHERE s.phase='live' AND NOT c.pinned AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM idempotency i WHERE i.conversation_id=s.conversation_id AND (i.execution_status IN ('queued','sending') OR (i.execution_status='delivered' AND i.updated_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - make_interval(secs => $4) AND i.updated_at > COALESCE((SELECT MAX(e.created_at) FROM events e WHERE e.conversation_id=s.conversation_id AND e.lifecycle IS NOT NULL), '-infinity'::timestamptz) AND COALESCE((SELECT e.lifecycle FROM events e WHERE e.conversation_id=s.conversation_id AND e.lifecycle IS NOT NULL ORDER BY e.seq DESC LIMIT 1), '') NOT IN ('run.started', 'run.resumed')))) AND ($2::uuid IS NULL OR c.owner_id=$2) AND (NOT $3::bool OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM templates t WHERE t.name=c.template AND 'desktop'=ANY(t.capabilities))) ORDER BY s.last_action_at LIMIT $1
